recommendedEntrypoints.name: global-codex
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: Use the global Lattice primary CLI for Codex-tagged operations after installing or linking the current package.

recommendedEntrypoints.name: local-wrapper
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: Use only when you need to prove the repository-local wrapper path or when the global CLI is unavailable.

recommendedEntrypoints.name: global-fallback
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: Only the global lattice CLI is available for read-only heartbeats; do not use it as current-worktree gate/status evidence when a local wrapper or core CLI exists.

notes: This file is read by Lattice tooling, not by the Codex runtime.
Codex agent prompts live in .Codex/agents and are generated from .claude/agents in full asset mode.
Claude Code hooks, settings, and skills remain under .claude only.
Run lattice codex verify after changing Codex adapter assets; it records codex_adapter_verification evidence for gates.
Legacy Koala projects may still use .Codex/koala.json and bin/koala-codex.js as compatibility assets.
